body:
RUNTIME PREFLIGHT, still read-only and no model download:

Current host is macOS 14.3 arm64 with system Python 3.14.7. The pinned parser setup.py declares Python 3.8-era dependencies: torch==1.13.1, numpy<=1.23.5, and fairseq==0.10.0 on Darwin. Therefore the system interpreter is correctly CLOSED/UNAVAILABLE, not a runtime candidate.

Exact AMR3 checkpoint identity is now closed without downloading bytes:
- model-hub commit 97e592a55e5d8c1c2faaea0ff2ef47d512c8f145
- path models/amr3.0-structured-bart-large-neur-al-seed42.zip
- Git LFS object sha256 f503fd95b98710feeebd6c225078e9b15c0743076383717eb8fee0c74bb33e67
- size 1,268,268,872 bytes

The pinned parser still calls torch.hub.load("pytorch/fairseq", name) when roberta_cache_path is absent. That is a mutable second model/code fetch. The extractor must require an explicit pinned BART directory/artifact and refuse startup when absent; from_pretrained is not an admissible production path.

Host has only 8.5 GiB free. I will not auto-download a 1.27 GB zip plus expanded checkpoint, BART, and Python environment into a shared cache. After contract landing I will propose an isolated runtime path and exact space preflight before requesting any download.

Contract identity needs at least parser code SHA, checkpoint sha256, BART artifact sha256, interpreter/environment lock digest, wrapper version, invocation config, and input digest. A single checkpoint field does not close the runtime.
